stem.text: A teacher sets up the apparatus shown to demonstrate a double-slit interference pattern on the screen.

stem.alt: Diagram of apparatus: a source of light, a single slit, a double slit and a screen on a horizontal line. Printed labels: source of light; single slit; double slit; screen; p and q (marked between the source and the double slit); r (marked between the double slit and the screen).

stem.text: Which change to the apparatus will increase the fringe spacing?

D.text: decreasing the wavelength of the light
